comment: water_damage() returns ER_NOTHING for a scroll of mail as for blank paper: global.h:430 defines MAIL_STRUCTURES unconditionally, so trap.c's SCR_MAIL test is compiled in. A Tourist in debug mode wishes for a scroll of mail and a fountain and dips the scroll twice; dipfountain() then skips its rn2(2) early return and goes straight to rnd(30). Independent seed, date and character.
